definitions.meaning: Exact UTF-8 alchLang source and its digest, language version, identities and correlation ID.
Content-bound evidence that the receiver compiled the source; not permission to execute it.
Same sender, receiver, correlation ID and exact envelope returns the previous receipt within one receiver lifetime.
Bounded named UTF-8 compiler artifact contents whose canonical digest is bound into the recipient receipt.

product_prototype.outcome: Two local agents exchange encrypted alchLang source through KEP; B compiles and returns actual artifact contents with a signed, digest-bound receipt.
product_prototype.business_limit: Private local prototype, no economic rights, payment, network deployment or received-code execution.

implementation.carrier: alchlang-source-v1 is an integration wire label, not a canonical language release
implementation.kep_transport: existing KEP Rust state kernel and ProductionCryptography adapter; local process only
implementation.receipt_authenticity: P-256 recipient signature verified against the disposable session public key; no remote identity trust claim
implementation.replay_scope: process-local, bounded 128 records; no durable exactly-once claim
implementation.are_mode: two runModelDrivenCodingTurn calls with scripted transports, isolated fixture files and separate ARE verifiers
implementation.simulation: simulate.py launches simulate.ts: same envelope, bundle and receipt definitions, two scripted ARE turns, real compiler, trusted in-memory handoff; no KEP, signatures or remote authentication
